review_kind: Independent semantic and quantifier review of other authors new-contract source files
scope: Only the new joint-decision closure and its frozen known-goal, positive-tariff, selected-parent, addresses-0-and-1 protocol. This review does not reopen or re-audit the previously completed Core closure.

findings: A finite atom enumeration carries theta and hidden population together; posterior uses the same joint branch as observation and successor.
Zero mass returns the prior only on an impossible branch; posterior_identity and total_expectation include this branch without manufacturing positive mass.
No world realization, protected program, actual parent identity or realized hidden atom is returned as a policy observation.
solve is a computable rational maximum over the explicit current action list; its returned observation-indexed table is the object bounded by optimality proofs.
Terminal payoff is zero and the frozen discount multiplies every remaining continuation.

The original Feasible/CausalPolicy definitions impose global off-path legality. This scope was identified as a real comparison-class gap and is not relabeled as support-local without the new SupportedPolicy proof.
tapeExpectation_eq_value binds the same returned table and finite observation law, not an existential substitute.
rows_exact binds every exported row to lookup in that table, including impossible rows.
WalletContract applies public prepayment before the outcome; feasible_prefix_ledger proves exact cumulative fees and balances at every supported prefix.
value_eq_source and the real causal analogue condition the same joint source; gain is the actual permitted receipt payoff.
traceExpectation_eq_source proves equality for every finite observation-tape test, not only scalar reward.
sourceTapeWeight/observedTape and observedTape_supported transfer every positive initial-atom/primitive-noise path to the model support needed by prefix-payment proofs.
The action menu checks public tariff times request cap against the public wallet before address lookup, mode or birth; genuine child-address None outcomes remain allowed.
The exact actual charge follows the paid-write receipt; tariff is strictly positive. A free tariff with the same fee flag would add information and is not covered.
advance clamps only impossible or unexecuted hypothetical rows; the supported wallet proof gives literal subtraction on every actual feasible branch.
initialBelief retains one theta and the hidden damaged founder; source.next never redraws theta. returned is the original solver output.
Free continuation is derived from the exhausted wallet. It compares both legal candidate addresses 0 and 1, stop and all free choices.
World-side health is used for the upper bound only. The attaining freeSchedule starts from the known successful first-write receipt and updates its two bits using only later birth receipts.
receipt_updates_health and step_health connect that update to the original selected-parent evolution. The same schedule attains the fixed-theta upper bound for every rational rate and finite horizon.
Later newborn addresses beyond 1 are real but outside the frozen request menu. The result is not a claim about arbitrary all-address dispatch or global simultaneous population faulting.
The main theorem has H+1 decisions, one tariff initially in the wallet and price*tariff at least the H-step geometric birth ceiling; there is no off-by-one strengthening.
A correct normal first write creates the real healthy root and child and exhausts the wallet. Every feasible success continuation is Free and bounded by twoBound.
A fault retains the actual failure slot and unspent wallet but leaves an all-damaged H-step process; the proved high-price no-go bounds every such continuation by zero.
Every other first action includes wrong paid writes, idle, stop and invalid child requests; each has no birth and leaves an all-damaged population.
The full fixed-theta process is evaluated before prior averaging. repairThenFree is one receipt-only attainer for all theta; its impossible branches are also feasible.

The exact formula is max(0, priorRepairScore). The two-sided positive-price boundary additionally assumes positive normalMean and retains its high-price regime. The small-wallet no-go applies at every finite horizon.

decision: No unresolved semantic defect found in the listed source-file snapshots under the stated frozen protocol and theorem hypotheses.
mandatory_boundaries: Known goal and aligned protected programs; no unknown-goal or hidden-program observation claim.
Source theta is drawn once; independent modes and fair birth labels are sampled conditionally on that retained theta.
Only the selected actual parent receives the original primitive fault/update in each serialized tick; other slots remain unchanged. This is not a parallel all-population-aging model.
No free parent identity, whole-Store read or physical-bit observation is added. Birth/charge prefix receipts are explicitly registered.
Stop means remaining actual root-idle steps; it does not freeze time or suppress physical births/faults.
J has frozen horizon, discount, full registered actual fees and zero terminal payoff. Solver hardware computation cost is not inserted into this physical objective.
Bayes-optimal expected net payoff, pathwise prepaid safety and probability of at least one birth are distinct claims.
Old counterexamples, actual original samples and empirical UNVERIFIED statuses must remain unchanged absent a located new error.
